meta.title: source-open-exchange-rates: Remove stream_state interpolation, update CDK
meta.body_summary: Remove stream_state interpolation from source-open-exchange-rates connector and update to latest CDK to support concurrent stream execution; bump patch version.

perf_labels.notes: Devin updated source-open-exchange-rates to remove stream_state interpolation and update CDK; pnilan approved with empty review body but PR was closed without merge after ~6 days.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 9642 changed lines across 196 files, this appears as a large change by absolute volume, but the vast majority comes from a merge of master; the actual source-open-exchange-rates changes are small (~50 lines). The PR was closed without merge despite an approval, likely due to inactivity or superseding.

review_details.concern_detail: No substantive review feedback; approval was submitted with empty body.
review_details.performance_claim: Enable concurrent stream execution by removing deprecated stream_state interpolation, replacing it with stream_interval.
review_details.rejection_signals: Closed without merge after approval; no explicit rejection comment. Likely stale or superseded.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Required updating a low-code connector to align with CDK version removal of stream_state; the change was straightforward manifest edits and version bumps, with no performance evidence needed. PR was approved but closed without merge, possibly due to process or alternative implementation.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No performance claim was quantified; the change is a structural refactor to remove a deprecated feature, so performance reproducibility is not relevant.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: PR closed without merge; no regression fix cycle.

core_change_summary.description: In manifest.yaml, replaced stream_state usage with stream_interval in the increments configuration; updated CDK version in metadata.yaml and bumped patch version; added changelog entry. The large merge commit from master brought in unrelated changes to many other connectors.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: All files under airbyte-integrations/connectors/ touched by the merge of master at commit 7fcd817d; the majority of diff is from bulk CDK and unrelated connector updates.
change_trajectory: Initial commit to trigger CI (metadata tweak).
Removed stream_state interpolation in manifest.yaml and added stream_interval.
Updated CDK version and bumped patch in metadata.yaml.
Reverted baseImage to specific version with SHA (ci fix).
pnilan fixed an error in manifest.yaml.
Merged latest master branch, bringing thousands of unrelated changes.

review_signals.summary: Formal APPROVED review with no comment.
Devin bot introduced the PR and noted it will watch for comments.

collaboration_trajectory: Devin opened PR based on internal Airbyte issue to remove stream_state.
pnilan approved within minutes with no feedback.
Over ~6 days, pnilan made minor edits (changelog, manifest fix) and merged master.
pnilan closed the PR without merge; no further discussion.
